proposals.rule: Short UI command labels (buttons, toggles, setting switches, link texts, menu commands) conventionally use the 2nd-person singular imperative, e.g. "Shrani", "Omogoči", "Posodobi", "Obnovi podatke". This is the standard Slovenian label form and is not a violation of the formal register; do not flag it or suggest the plural ("Shranite", "Obnovite podatke"). The formal register (vikanje, e.g. "Prepričajte se, da …") still applies to full sentences and prose addressed to the user; informal singular forms in such prose remain a defect.
